Package com.signalwire.sdk.swml

Interface WireEnum

All Known Implementing Classes:
Codec, RecordDirection, RecordFormat, TapDirection
public interface WireEnum
Marker for the typed, compile-time-checked closed-set enums whose constants carry a canonical wire string (RecordFormat, RecordDirection, TapDirection, Codec).

Every such enum already exposes getValue() returning the exact string the SignalWire platform expects on the wire (e.g. "mp3", "listen", "PCMU"). This interface simply names that shared shape so a single API can accept any of them generically — most importantly ParameterSchema.Builder.enumOf(String, WireEnum[], String), which turns RecordFormat.values() into a JSON-schema enum:[...] of wire strings without per-enum overloads.

Because Java arrays are covariant, RecordFormat.values() (typed RecordFormat[]) is directly usable wherever a WireEnum[] is expected. The interface adds no new method to the enums — getValue() already existed — so it is purely a unifying type, and routing a value through it is byte-for-byte identical to passing its getValue() string.

This is the SWAIG/SWML "has a canonical wire value" set only. It is deliberately NOT implemented by RELAY device codecs or other open-ended string fields — see the per-enum Javadoc for the 3-vocabulary trap.
